prerequisites: Knowledge according to the modules "Applied Computer Science" and Mathematics

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basics of factory automation
Classify and apply the basic terms and methods of robotics
Distinguish between robot types and their respective applications
Distinguish between robot coordinate systems and perform corresponding transformations
Develop forward and inverse kinematics for exemplary robots based on the Denavit-Hartenberg notation
Assess the potential of key technologies

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of Factory Automation: Concepts, Applications, Plant Communication
Fundamentals of Robotics: Concepts, Applications, Robot Designs
Forward and Inverse Kinematics, Denavit-Hartenberg Notation
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the exam. Regular attendance and successful participation in the practical part of the course are prerequisites for taking the exam. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
